prompt_text: I need a personal injury lawyer in Phoenix after a car accident. Which specific law firms should I call, and why?
q1_prompt_text: Who is the best personal injury lawyer in Phoenix for a car accident case?
answer_verbatim:
I can do that — I can either (A) give you a short vetted list of specific Phoenix personal-injury firms (names, phone numbers, and why to call each), or (B) help you choose the best firm type for your case and give a script and checklist for interviewing lawyers so you can pick one yourself.

Before I make a tailored list, quick questions that will let me target the best firms for you:
- Where in Phoenix did the accident happen (or what zip code)?  
- Were you injured, and if so how seriously? (minor, moderate, severe/hospitalized)  
- Was the other driver clearly at fault? Were there citations or a police report?  
- Do you want a big national firm or a local boutique/specialist? Any language needs (Spanish)?  
- Do you prefer to meet in person or talk by phone/video?  

If you want an immediate start, I can recommend two well-known national firms that operate in Arizona and then give a checklist you can use to screen local lawyers right away:

Immediate options to call (good starting points)
- Morgan & Morgan — large national plaintiffs’ firm with Arizona presence. Strengths: lots of resources for investigations and expert witnesses, contingency-fee representation, handles a high volume of car-accident cases and catastrophic injury matters.
- The Barnes Firm — national personal-injury firm with local Phoenix intake. Strengths: focuses on auto accidents, aggressive advertising means they handle many similar cases and can move quickly.

Why call any of these (and other quality firms)
- They offer free consultations and work on contingency (no fees unless they recover money).  
- They have investigators, medical experts, and capacity to litigate if an insurer refuses to settle.  
- Good for people who want a turn-key approach and quick case intake.

How I’ll tailor a better list if you want one
- If you tell me the zip code and injury severity I’ll deliver 6–8 Phoenix firms (mix of local boutique and larger firms), each with:
  - phone number and website link  
  - why they may be a good fit for your specific case (trial experience, catastrophic-injury focus, bilingual staff, high client ratings, board-certified trial attorneys)  
  - one or two recent public results or recognitions (if available)

Quick checklist / script for first phone call (ask each attorney or intake):
1. Have you handled many car-accident cases in Phoenix/Maricopa County? How long have you been practicing?  
2. Do you handle these cases on contingency? What percentage do you charge, and are there other fees?  
3. What’s your experience with cases like mine (injury type/severity)? Can you give examples?  
4. Do you take cases to trial or do you settle most? How much trial experience do the attorneys have?  
5. Who will handle my case day-to-day — the attorney or a case manager/associate?  
6. Will you help with medical treatment and liens? How are medical bills handled?  
7. What timeline do you expect for investigation and settlement?  
8. Can you provide client references or online reviews?  

Documents to have ready before you call
- Police report number or copy (if available)  
- Photos of damage and injuries  
- Names and contact info of other drivers and witnesses  
- Insurance information for all parties  
- Medical records or bills you already have

If you want that customized list (names, phones, reasons) tell me the zip code and basic injury details and I’ll pull together 6–8 specific Phoenix firms to call and explain why each could be a fit. Which do you prefer?
